text:
mike: Heads-up — starting change window for release 2.3.1 in ~10m. Deploy bot will ramp canary 10% -> 50% over 15m. Please watch SLO dashboards and call pin/rollback if anything unusual :eyes:
ops-bot: @mike scheduled rollout 2.3.1: canary=10% at 2026-03-22T10:45:43Z, ramp->50% over 15m. /deploy status will post updates here.
sre-elena: quick ask — can we add a short hysteresis to SLO alerting for this rollout? We had a 90s p95 blip last week that auto-paused a healthy deploy. Current watch: p95 > 250ms for 2m. proposing: require p95 > 250ms for 5m OR (p95 > 300ms for 2m AND error_rate > 0.4% for 3m).
mike: yes, agree. want to avoid premature pins. the second clause looks reasonable — protects against short p95 spikes without errors.
adele: fyi embeds-route in eu-west has been noisy for the last hour (small batch of 502s). Recommend region-aware pin so we don't do a global rollback if it's regional.
product-lydia: release notes are ready. if we pin, let's capture the decision and add a short blameless note in the release doc so customers have context.
sre-elena: pasted alert rule we're going to apply (adjusted):
```
alert: DeployWindowP95Thermostat
expr: (p95_request_latency_ms > 250)[5m] and (increase(p95_request_latency_ms[5m]) > 0)
or ((p95_request_latency_ms > 300)[2m] and (request_error_rate > 0.004)[3m])
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: high
  action: hold-if-canary
annotations:
  summary: "P95 latency thermostat during deploy window"
```
sre-elena: I'll apply as a temporary rule for the next 40m. If it helps, we can add a short cooldown so the deploy bot needs an explicit ack to pause.
ops-bot: alerting config updated for rollout 2.3.1 by sre-elena. Temporary rule TTL=40m. Deploy bot hold threshold now reads: p95 thermostat + error-rate cross-check.
mike: starting first shift now (10%). Keep eyes on embedds route and global 5xx counts.
adele: seeing p95 spike to ~320ms in eu-west at ~10:47, but error rate still ~0.05% and 5xx stable. Not triggering hold thanks to hysteresis. tagging traces: link to traces (internal).
sre-elena: good catch on traces — looks like a short GC storm on a couple hosts, not model perf. leaving thermostat in place.
mike: thumbs-up. continue ramping to 50%. If we see sustained error-rate uptick to >0.4% for 3m, that's a different story and we'll pause.
product-lydia: echo — if we pause, we add a short customer note + signal in the release doc.
ops-bot: traffic ramp to 50% in progress — canary 30% at 10:50, 50% expected by 10:58. Will post updates.
adele: ping — p95 back to baseline ~180ms at 10:52. No hold required. :thumbsup:
sre-elena: thermostat behaved as intended. Recommending we add this hysteresis to the default deploywatch policy for next sprint.
mike: agreed. will file a follow-up ticket to bake into deploy defaults and update the runbook. Thanks everyone.
